name: Dreadlocks
overview: Scripture addresses the treatment and appearance of hair in several passages, emphasizing respect for God's design and specific vows of separation. Leviticus instructs against cutting the hair at the corners of the head or shaving the beard, indicating a call to honor God’s order in personal grooming. The Nazirite vow in Numbers requires letting the hair grow without a razor as a sign of holiness and dedication to the Lord. Samson’s story in Judges illustrates the spiritual significance of his uncut hair, as the loss of his seven locks led to the loss of his strength. These verses collectively highlight that hair, including its length and maintenance, can symbolize covenant faithfulness and consecration to God.
